name: Lesson 2 How did they become great?
definition: 学习谈论伟大人物的品质与事迹，了解用一般过去时描述人物如何取得成就。
key_points: 核心词汇：great, scientist, kung fu star, hard-working, brave, fireman, put out fires, keep ... safe, never gave up, worked day and night, favourite, invented, feed
核心句型：He/She was a(n) ... / He/She was great because ... / Why do you like him/her? / He/She is my favourite ... / I like ... best
语法点：一般过去时叙述事迹（worked, showed, invented, did）；形容词的用法（hard-working, brave, kind）
common_mistakes: 叙述过去事迹时动词忘记用过去式
like ... best 与 like ... better 混用
never gave up 时态前后不一致
publisher: 广东教育出版社（粤教沪外教版）
